submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed no candidate exposure with a significant linear association with species_richness after adjusting for region (all single-exposure OLS p>0.12; soil_moisture was the strongest at p≈0.12). The pre-registered confirmatory OLS of species_richness on soil_moisture plus site indicators on held-out data gave estimate −0.134 (SE 0.114), p=0.241, not significant at alpha=0.05. The exploratory signal did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
expos = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
def fit(d, cols):
    y = d['species_richness'].values
    X = d[cols].values
    reg = pd.get_dummies(d['region'], drop_first=True).values.astype(float)
    Xf = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(d)), X, reg])
    beta,*_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Xf,y,rcond=None)
    resid = y - Xf@beta
    n,k = Xf.shape
    s2 = resid@resid/(n-k)
    cov = s2*np.linalg.inv(Xf.T@Xf)
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
    return beta, se, n-k
print("QUADRATIC:")
for e in expos:
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness',e]).copy()
    d['x2']=d[e]**2
    beta,se,dof = fit(d,[e,'x2'])
    t2 = beta[2]/se[2]; p2 = 2*(1-stats.t.cdf(abs(t2),dof))
    t1 = beta[1]/se[1]; p1 = 2*(1-stats.t.cdf(abs(t1),dof))
    print(f"{e:16s} lin p={p1:.4f}  quad p={p2:.4f}")
